name: capacity-ramp
description: Bounded capacity ramp on named volumes: 1280 MiB per file and 64 GiB per task; the full 100 GB chain still requires a POSIX capacity filesystem
notes: The batch budget always holds at least one legal file: one batch is exactly one 1280 MiB file.

The scanner wall budget is fixed at 300 s per batch; measured effective scan throughput on this host is about 10.7 MiB/s, so one 1280 MiB file takes roughly 120 s and leaves about 180 s of wall margin.
This profile makes the large per-file limit runnable on Docker named volumes for bounded ramps; named-volume capacity is bounded by the Docker disk image and is not a 100 GB qualification.
The full 100 GB chain needs a POSIX filesystem with two complete copies plus reserve and must run with large-repository.
